text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to the support of the URA and various quarters,
we've prepared an environment beyond our initial expectations.
choice_data_list: The Chairwoman has helped me out in so many ways...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid, splendid! Compared to the hardships you've endured, convincing the board of directors is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: So, how does our team's strength actually look?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Based on the data compiled for regular reports
to the URA, this is the current evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then I shall make an appearance today as well!
